title: Coin Dash
shows: A small, complete game: title screen, settings with rebindable keys, timed rounds, a pause and a saved best time (kept in the browser's storage), in English and Arabic (the settings switch the language).
alt: The Coin Dash title screen: the name in gold on dark blue, with the keys to play and open the settings

title: Ember Hop
shows: A second complete game: a platformer through two cave levels from the Tiled editor, with physics, prefabs, particles, streamed music, a following camera and saves at the braziers.
alt: The Ember Hop title screen above a cave floor with mushrooms, crystals and glowing sparks

title: Tutorial: Crab Cove
shows: The finished game of the 2D tutorial: a Tiled level with solid tiles, coins, water, a flag, sound, a title screen and a saved best score.
alt: A blue sky over grass platforms and water, with the Crab Cove menu open: Play and Quit

title: Legions
shows: The simulation showcase: two armies of soldiers and archers on flow fields, with spatial-grid targeting, arrows, the fallen, animated sprites in one instanced batch, and replays that end with the same world hash. 10,000 units in the browser (100,000 natively).
alt: Two columns of soldiers, red and blue, facing each other across a muddy field with rocks

title: Battle
shows: Two armies of 10,000 units marching on shared flow fields and fighting, with a spatial grid for targeting and seeded randomness.
alt: Red and blue armies spread across a muddy field between rocks, with the numbers of each side at the top left

title: Flow fields
shows: 20,000 agents following one shared flow field around walls and through mud, recomputed when the goal moves.
alt: Thousands of yellow agents streaming along branching paths around dark obstacles

title: Ant colonies
shows: Ants forage and lay pheromone trails: a spatial grid, a field shared by every ant, systems at reduced rates and entities taking turns.
alt: A black field with a blue nest in the middle and green food dots around it

title: Boids
shows: Flocking (separation, alignment and cohesion) with a spatial grid for the neighbour search.
alt: An orange field packed with thousands of small flocking birds

title: Bunnymark (ECS)
shows: Bouncing sprites stored as entities and drawn by the built-in sprite system: a stress test for sprite batching.
alt: A block of thousands of small orange sprites in a corner of a dark screen

title: Sprites
shows: Drawing sprites: position, rotation, scale, tint, draw order and pivot.
alt: Crab sprites in a row and a ring of coloured dots around a large crab

title: Sprite effects
shows: Sprite blend modes and sprite shaders: an additive glow, an outline and a dissolve.
alt: Three crabs side by side: one with an orange glow, one outlined, one dissolving into sparks

title: 2D particles
shows: A campfire of smoke, fire and sparks around a sprite, a glowing trail and bursts: emitters sorted among the sprites.
alt: A small campfire of sparks and confetti around a crab on a dark background

title: 2D lights
shows: A dark tile dungeon lit by wandering coloured lights with shadows from the walls and crates, normal-mapped tiles and a lantern that follows the mouse.
alt: A dark tiled dungeon lit in red, green, blue and yellow, with long shadows from crates

title: Tilemap
shows: A million-tile map with animated sprites on it; only the tiles in view are drawn.
alt: A green tilemap with a sandy area and scattered red sprites, and the sprite count at the top left

title: 2D physics
shows: Crates, balls and rocks fall, stack, bounce and slide down a ramp, with a sensor in the bucket.

title: Tiled level
shows: A level from the Tiled map editor: parallax clouds, animated water, coins placed as objects and colliders made from the tiles.
alt: A grass and earth platform with coins, clouds and a little water, on a dark background

title: Editor playground
shows: The editor in the runtime inspector: pause the game, then select, move, duplicate and place entities, with undo; Play and Stop restore the scene.
alt: Small crab sprites scattered over a dark blue screen

title: Camera, text and UI
shows: A 2D camera, shapes, text and buttons in one small scene.
alt: A checkered floor with a crab, a large blue circle and two buttons at the top left

title: UI: a shop
shows: Retained UI: an item grid that scrolls, a text input, a toggle and a modal confirmation dialog.
alt: A shop window: a grid of twelve items with prices, a gift wrap checkbox and a Buy button

title: UI: a settings menu
shows: A settings menu operated by keyboard and mouse, with named controls for screen readers on the desktop.
alt: A settings menu with a Play button, a volume slider, a name field and a Music checkbox

title: 2D skeletons
shows: A puppet with rigid parts and a skinned tail: a walk-run blend, a jump from a trigger, a look at the mouse and two-bone IK reaching for it.
alt: A small orange puppet standing on a dark grey screen

title: Behaviour trees
shows: Guards whose behaviour trees come from a data file: they walk their rounds, chase the intruder they see, and go home to rest when tired or hurt.
alt: Guards with large blue view circles on patrol, and one red circle where a guard chases

title: Prefabs
shows: Prefabs with children: carts with wheels, a driver and the driver's hat, from one prefab file that includes another.
alt: Two small carts with drivers on a dark screen

title: Coming from Bevy
shows: One sprite sliding left and right: a port of Bevy's move_sprite example, walked through in the guide's "Coming from Bevy" chapter.
alt: A red panda face on the right of a dark screen

title: UI widgets
shows: The retained UI's widget set: a settings page with tabs, a dropdown, radio buttons, a number field and a key binding, and an inventory of 10,000 cells with drag and drop and a context menu.
alt: A light settings page with tabs, a dropdown, radio buttons and a number field

title: Shard Grove
shows: The complete 3D game: a glTF level and skinned glTF characters with animation state machines, a character controller, enemies that chase on a navigation mesh, positional sound, lights and shadows, menus, a HUD, a sign in the world, quality presets and saves at the shrines.
alt: The Shard Grove menu over a walled grove seen from above: New game, Continue and Settings

title: 3D scene
shows: Meshes, materials, a sun with shadows and hundreds of instanced models spinning.
alt: Rows of small coloured shapes on a green field, with a line of red spheres in front

title: Tutorial: Lantern Yard
shows: The finished game of the 3D tutorial: a glTF yard that is drawn and solid, a character controller, a following camera, lights, crates and a HUD.

title: Many lights
shows: A dark scene lit by a hundred coloured point and spot lights.
alt: A dark floor of small cubes lit by dozens of coloured point lights

title: Terrain
shows: Heightfield terrain drawn coarser with distance, with grass, dirt and rock blended by a weight map, and a water-kit lake that mirrors the hills, with the underwater view when you dive in.
alt: Green hills and shallow turquoise water stretching to the horizon

title: Material shaders
shows: Custom material shaders (a lake with waves, grass in the wind, a procedural pattern) with post-processing.
alt: A pond with waves, a field of grass blades and a checkered ball

title: Streaming landscape
shows: An endless landscape streamed in around a flying camera: terrain tiles built as jobs, uploaded a couple a frame and freed once far behind.
alt: Green rolling hills fading into haze

title: Skinned meshes
shows: Procedural tentacles on skeletons, posed every frame; on WebGL2 the skinning runs on the CPU.
alt: Three green bending tubes standing on a white floor

title: 3D particles
shows: A billboard particle emitter: a cone of additive sparks with gravity, drag and colour over their life.
alt: A small burst of orange sparks on a dark background

title: Trails and lines
shows: A ribbon trail behind an orbiting ball, lines and decals.
alt: A green floor with a dark object and a small white light trailing a ribbon

title: UI in the 3D world
shows: Retained UI drawn on a panel in the 3D world, aimed at with the middle of the screen.
alt: A blue panel floating above a green field under a pale sky

title: Depth of field
shows: A target effect: the lit frame copied into a small render target and blended back in for a cheap depth of field.
alt: Two rows of wooden crates on grass casting soft shadows

title: Stencil
shows: Materials with a stencil state: crossing glass strips that blend once where they overlap, beside a pair without one that blends twice, and a turning crate with an outline drawn only around it.
alt: A yellow-outlined box between two blue crosses on a green field

title: 3D physics
shows: First-person walking over hilly terrain: a character controller that climbs steps, and crates to push over.
alt: Orange crates tumbling across a green field

title: Vehicle
shows: A box car on four raycast wheels driving over hilly terrain.
alt: A red box-shaped car on a green field

title: Sky kit
shows: The ready-made sky: drifting clouds and their shadows on the ground, a moon with phases and turning stars, through a day on fast forward.
alt: Tall stone pillars against a low sun and a hazy sky

title: A sky of your own
shows: A painted sky shader with banded colours and flat clouds through a day; the fog, the reflections and the ambient light take its colours.
alt: Pillars and shiny spheres under a pink and purple evening sky

title: Reflections through a day
shows: Mirror balls and a polished floor whose reflection probe captures the sky again as the sun crosses it, easing each capture in.

title: Post volumes
shows: The camera walks from a meadow through a cave into a sunset garden, and the picture's look blends as it crosses each volume.

title: Split screen
shows: Two players, each seen by their own camera in their half of the window, with a minimap of icons the players' cameras leave out.
alt: Two views side by side over a green field with coloured blocks, labelled Player 1 and Player 2

title: A crowd of 10,000
shows: A plaza of 10,000 skinned people in a handful of draws, their clips advanced on the GPU, every two seconds another section cheering.
alt: A huge crowd of small coloured figures filling a flat plain

title: Water
shows: A lake with a reflection and shoreline foam, a river carried by a flow map and the sea's waves, with crates floating on all three and ripples where they splash.
alt: Blue-green sea waves rolling onto a sandy beach, with floating buoys

title: Compute: rain on a pond
shows: A wave simulation in a compute pass on the GPU every frame, read by the water's shader to bend its normals.
alt: A round pool of rippling blue water ringed by grey stones

title: Compute: eye adaptation
shows: A compute pass that measures how bright each frame is and keeps a running average, so the picture settles as the sun rises and sets.
alt: Two rows of wooden crates on grass under a pale sky
